opening.argument: The presentation is structured as interview preparation, beginning with “top most interview questions and answers for freshers/experienced” and developing sample responses for common workplace scenarios. It asks how to handle a rude or upset customer, advises viewers to “Remain calm! The number 1 rule of the customer service is to never lose your temper with a customer,” and introduces further questions about being goal-oriented and why an employer should hire the candidate. The pen or suntan-lotion segment functions as a sales-answer exercise within that interview preparation, rather than a direct offer to buy, pay, or provide financial information. The request to find more videos on YouTube is an ordinary channel-contact method and does not establish a financial solicitation or transaction.
